messages:
sara_cust: Hi, urgent compliance ask from a customer. They need consolidated evidence for EU data erasure for tenant T-783: (1) proof of record deletion, (2) KMS/HSM key rotation/zeroization attestation, (3) audit export for 2025-11-01..2026-02-28. When we call /admin/audit/export we hit 401. Can we triage ASAP?

liz_support: Got it. Can you paste the exact curl and response body? Also confirm org id and whether this is Hosted, Dedicated, or Private.

sara_cust: Hosted account. org: org_945. curl I used:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" "https://api.redwood.ai/admin/audit/export?start=2025-11-01&end=2026-02-28"
# HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
# {\"error\":\"unauthorized\",\"message\":\"token expired\"}
```
Token still works for normal API calls, billing endpoints were fine earlier.

liz_support: Thanks. Two quick asks: (1) capture full response headers (use -i) and (2) try admin API key from Console > Settings > API keys (some tokens lack admin scope).

sara_cust: Tried admin key from console, still 401. Response headers include: `Server: redwood`, `X-Region: eu-west-1`, `X-Request-Id: req-7c9a2`.

marcus_privsec: Looping in PrivSec. Quick note on HSM: we cannot provide raw key material or physical zeroization logs (HSM is FIPS-certified). What we can provide as regulator-facing evidence: KMS audit events showing create/rotate/disable timestamps, KMS operation logs (encrypt/decrypt/delete), and the HSM vendor attestation we received during onboarding. For deletion: DB deletion events, object-store tombstone entries, and CDC offsets showing downstream purge applied. Do they need a signed DPA addendum?

sara_cust: Customer wants a single deliverable package they can hand to a regulator: deletion export + KMS timeline + HSM attestation + backup scrub evidence. They also asked that backups with EU residency be proven scrubbed.

jordan_sre: For Hosted EU residency: snapshots/backups are kept in eu-west-1. We can include a snapshot manifest showing retention and deletion timestamps. I'm starting an export now using the request id from your header (req-7c9a2). Also note: the export API requires org_admin role and the `audit:export` scope.

kms-bot: Export job submitted: job_id=job-9923, queued on eu-queue. ETA ~3m. Reply with `status job-9923` to get progress.

liz_support: I'll assemble the package and escalate to Compliance Ops to sign attestation. Sara — can you send the customer's legal contact and preferred delivery method (S3 link vs encrypted zip email)?

sara_cust: legal@custco.com. They prefer encrypted S3 (customer-managed KMS if possible). Also note: they reported a ~$3k billing spike correlated with an export job last week — can someone confirm whether audit exports are billed as egress?

marcus_privsec: Audit export artifacts should remain within the same region (no egress). A billing spike likely comes from heavy query/scan charges during the export. We'll open a billing ticket and correlate by job_id.

jordan_sre: Progress update: job-9923 -> running

kms-bot: job-9923 -> complete. artifacts: s3://redwood-exports/eu-org_945/job-9923/audit.zip (encrypted). checksum: sha256:abc123def4567890

sara_cust: Received artifact link, downloading to verify contents. Thanks everyone — I'll confirm with the customer and reopen if regulator requests additional detail."
